HTTP 200、finish_reason 是正常 stop，但整条响应一个内: HTTP 200, finish_reason is a normal stop, but the whole response has no content block — gateway empty frames, dropped thinking frames, or sampling hiccups all look like this.
其余状态码（400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 413 / 422: Other status codes (400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 413 / 422, etc.) are deterministic rejections; resending fails the same way, so throw immediately.
前面几层都没兜住：worker 以 model_error 收场——内层重试全部: None of the earlier layers caught it: the worker ends in model_error — inner retries exhausted, or the stream broke after output delivery began (replay is unsafe then, so the whole thing reruns).
原样重发同一个请求。流一旦开始（已经拿到 200），中途断开就不归这层管了。: Resend the same request as-is. Once the stream starts (HTTP 200 received), a mid-stream break is out of this layer's scope.
因 max_tokens 截断而没有内容的不算（那要靠调高输出上限解决，重发只会: Doesn't count if there's no content due to max_tokens truncation (fix that by raising the output limit; resending just hits it again).
在同一个配置上重放同一个请求。因为还没交付任何输出，重放不会重复模型输出或工具执: Replay the same request on the same config. Since no output was delivered yet, replaying won't duplicate model output or tool execution.
存在相同参数的并发调用，无法唯一关联工具调用；本记录不展示推测的执行结果。: Concurrent calls with identical params exist; the tool call can't be uniquely linked, so this record omits the inferred execution result.
整条意图从头再跑一遍。它是最外层，一次重跑意味着里面几层的次数会再乘一遍。: Rerun the whole intent from scratch. It's the outermost layer, so one rerun multiplies the inner layers' counts again.
流已经建立（拿到 200）之后才出问题：连接中途断开、供应商 overloade: Problems that occur after the stream is established (HTTP 200): mid-stream disconnect, provider overloaded, in-stream 429 / 5xx error events — and not a single token delivered to the caller yet.
瞬时失败（429、5xx、网络错误）连续累计到阈值时熔断；余额不足（402）、密: Transient failures (429, 5xx, network errors) trip the breaker when they accumulate to the threshold; deterministic failures like insufficient balance (402), invalid key (401/403), or missing model (404) ignore the threshold and break on the first.
熔断后进入冷却，冷却期内轮询直接跳过这个配置。状态落库，重启不丢。: After tripping, it enters cooldown; during cooldown the pool skips this config. State is persisted and survives restarts.
重发整个 prompt，所以在长上下文上比较贵，次数不宜给大。: Resends the whole prompt, so it's costly on long contexts — keep the count small.
额度耗尽已经由轮询换配置处理，不在这里重跑；任务被暂停 / 终止 / 进入收尾时: Quota exhaustion is handled by pool failover, not reran here; it yields immediately when the task is paused / terminated / entering wrapup, without consuming backoff time.
额度耗尽（402 / insufficient_quota，交给轮询换配置）、上: Quota exhaustion (402 / insufficient_quota, handed to pool failover), context too long (413 / context length, handed to compaction), and 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 422 deterministic rejections are all not retried.
连不上或还没拿到 200：连接重置 / 读写超时 / DNS 失败等网络层错误，: Can't connect or no HTTP 200 yet: network-layer errors like connection reset / read-write timeout / DNS failure, plus HTTP 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504.
